In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
software component licenses are a critical factor that must be considered in the evolution of open architecture software systems and their ecosystems.

the software ecosystem niche of a system composed of open architecture components under multiple licenses can be determined by examining the architecture and software licenses of the system at design time and build time.

software licenses are a key factor in defining the software ecosystem niches of open architecture systems, and that understanding these niches and how they evolve is a crucial step in understanding and managing the evolution of open architecture software ecosystems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the software component licenses and architectural compositions of a system are key in determining the system's software ecosystems, and the system's ecosystem in turn helps to define the system's niche.
licenses and architecture are key factors in determining the evolution of software systems.

the software ecosystem niche of an open architecture system is determined by the licenses of the software components and the architectural composition at design time, the licenses of the components and the composition at build time, and the licenses of the deployed components at run time, and these licenses and architectural compositions help to define evolutionary paths of the system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
software ecosystem niches are a useful concept for characterizing the evolution of open architecture software systems.
licenses are an integral part of the software ecosystem niche of an open architecture system, which in turn affects its evolution.
the software ecosystem niche of an open architecture system is defined at design time by the architecture of the system, and at build time and run time by its licenses.
